source.observable: VideoFromComponents ten-bit output multiplies the first three float channels by 65535, clamps and truncates to native little-endian uint16 RGB48LE, converts to YUV420P10LE, and writes source-order H.264 MP4 frames

contract.profile: MP4 with the retained provider-proved libx264 descriptor, RGB48LE source, YUV420P10LE destination, checked rational frame rate and global-header policy
contract.quantization: multiply the first three source channels by 65535, clamp to [0,65535], truncate to U16, store each channel little-endian in packed RGB order, and discard a fourth alpha channel
contract.batch_lifecycle: the existing bounded retained sequence session owns increasing frame PTS, per-frame packet draining, one terminal flush, one trailer, and final-only attempt-local bytes
contract.abi: the supplementary FFmpeg 7.1 compiler projection reviews RGB48LE=35 and reuses the reviewed YUV420P10LE=62 with zero new symbols
